#include <iostream>
#include <string>
using namespace std;

int main() {
    string s;
    cin >> s;
    int count = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < s.length(); ) {
        char current = s[i];
        int j = i + 1;
        while (j < s.length() && s[j] == current) {
            j++;
        }
        if (((j - i) & 1) == 0) {
            count++;
        }
        i = j;
    }
    cout << count;
    return 0;
}
